title: IDPC Decision 2026: CCTV camera capturing public spaces and/or third-party properties.
text:
Type: Data Protection complaint

Description: CCTV camera capturing public spaces and/or third-party properties.

Outcome: Infringement of articles 5(1)(a) and 5(1)(c) GDPR.

Corrective Action: Order, in terms of article 58(2)(f) GDPR.
corrective_action: Order, in terms of article 58(2)(f) GDPR.
